Welcome to FSU! This website will have what you need to participate in the R workshop 
and additional resources to aid you in learning how to code in R. At FSU, all methods
courses use the R language for running statistical analysis. Therefore, learning R 
is very important, but do not fear. You do not need to have any prior knowledge in R 
in order to be successful at FSU. 

This workshop is intended to introduce new PhD students to R. It starts at the 
beginning with downloading R and RStudio and is designed to ensure that students 
feel comfortable running commands in R to prepare for the method's sequence. 

Special thanks to Austin Cutler. The vast majority of these materials were put together
by him from past years he taught this workshop. 

### [Course Materials](materials_update.qmd)

This page has all the materials for each day of class. This includes the slides, 
example code, and related files.

### [Homework](homework_update.qmd)

This page has the homework for each day of class. It also includes a link to a 
Dropbox folder where you will submit the homework assignments. These assignments 
are designed to give you practice with the skills we will learn in the workshop. 

### [Data](data.qmd)

This page is where you can find the data we will use for class. Each dataset is
linked in its section heading. Underneath each heading, you will find sample code
for reading the data into R.

### [Additional Resources](additional_resources.qmd)

This page links to other resources that can make learning R a little easier.
